details.body:
You must register for Self Assessment if you have to send a tax return.

Register by 5 October in your business's second tax year. You could be fined if you do not register by this deadline.

When to register

If you are newly self-employed you must register as soon as you can after starting your business. The latest you can register is 5 October after the end of the tax year in which you became self-employed.

For example, if you started working for yourself in June 2024, you must register by 5 October 2025.

How to register

You register online with HMRC. You will get a Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) by post within 10 working days. Keep your UTR safe, you need it to file your return.
